### Separate composition review: performance admission held

The independent M7 composition derived from the G3 resolution query, with additional NULL/BINARY preservation and a separate surface query, was not integrated into PR #180. Its complete five-file candidate, static acceptance and subsequent bounded performance counterevidence are preserved at [fixed SQL review checkpoint 80d7979](https://github.com/jyqj/codecortex/tree/80d7979da10ae242ed4706cd04be74c62194261a/artifacts/checkpoints/p8-SQL-exclusion-hold-a217-20261009).

Four constructed Python/SQLite cases retained exact output parity, but SQL execute/fetch elapsed time increased. Sparse and multi-batch cases show that the JSON membership structure may be rebuilt for each statement execution, so reduced returned rows or VM counts alone do not establish faster queries. The probe does not time Rust JSON serialization or measure this PR's exact G4 binary; the surface-query case also lies outside this PR's production scope. It is concrete evidence to resolve before treating this strategy as a performance improvement, alongside this PR's original sparse-exclusion VM counterexample.

PR #188 remains separately reviewable and Draft while its exact-head CI and performance interpretation are resolved. Its source has not been absorbed by the format-only M7F update of #180. No original TODO or original scale result changes.

### Separate composition review: performance admission held

The independent M7 composition derived from the G3 resolution query, with additional NULL/BINARY preservation and a separate surface query, was not integrated into PR #180. Its complete five-file candidate, static acceptance and subsequent bounded performance counterevidence are preserved at [fixed SQL review checkpoint 80d7979](https://github.com/jyqj/codecortex/tree/80d7979da10ae242ed4706cd04be74c62194261a/artifacts/checkpoints/p8-SQL-exclusion-hold-a217-20261009).

Four constructed Python/SQLite cases retained exact output parity, but SQL execute/fetch elapsed time increased. Sparse and multi-batch cases show that the JSON membership structure may be rebuilt for each statement execution, so reduced returned rows or VM counts alone do not establish faster queries. The probe does not time Rust JSON serialization or measure this PR's exact G4 binary; the surface-query case also lies outside this PR's production scope. It is concrete evidence to resolve before treating this strategy as a performance improvement, alongside this PR's original sparse-exclusion VM counterexample.

PR #188 remains separately reviewable and Draft while its exact-head CI and performance interpretation are resolved. Its source has not been absorbed by the format-only M7F update of #180. No original TODO or original scale result changes.

Borrow SQLite row text during exact canonical JSON projection to remove temporary owned text copies. Preserve the original field ordering, duplicate-column result, real-number encoding, escaped-byte budgets and error order.

This remains a Draft against the fixed review base `fffd950d5b34b0180f308db1428a57d5bf358bf1`. Current head is **`9ddae045f6925140a4d652c5f28f64add459eff1`**, a formatter-only successor of the original cost-study source.

## Actual correctness verification

All three jobs in [ordinary CI run 37961137036](https://github.com/jyqj/codecortex/actions/runs/37961137036) passed; the [main check](https://github.com/jyqj/codecortex/actions/runs/37961137036/job/113923960385) finished at **2026-10-09 17:48:54 UTC**. Its complete original log and independent review are retained. The actual PR test-merge tree exactly equals the reviewed head tree `20ae2605cad47e1b56c80e5f83278bbd34744982`.

Formatting, Clippy, all-target compilation, authorized regressions and the original source/task guards passed. Each of the four new controls actually passed in both default and eval-http executions:

- Reordered and duplicate columns produce the original bytes.
- Escaped byte lengths preserve row-boundary budgets.
- SELECT errors retain their order and subsequent recovery behavior.
- Real values retain the original Value encoding.

The finite ignored cost probe remained ignored in these ordinary regression executions.

## Cost observations and adoption decision

**Default adoption remains on hold.** The original cost study is [run 37956976406](https://github.com/jyqj/codecortex/actions/runs/37956976406), source **`eded24951c3e99693410ce959a627ab575f66bec`**. It retains all **100 measurements: five cases × 20 alternating-order pairs**, with complete byte assertions. No observations were trimmed.

The four smaller/blob cases were faster in all 20 pairs. The `multiple_text` case had median paired borrowed/original ratio **1.0664289** and was faster in only 10/20 pairs. Ordering matters: its medians were 1.2050854 with original-first and 0.9557795 with borrowed-first. The first side's result vector also remained live while the second side was timed. These observations do not establish an end-to-end parity or indexing improvement.

A separately prepared equal-lifetime candidate remains an untriggered, archived alternative. Its code and prospective measurements are not credited to this PR or the original study.

## Preserved evidence and scope

The [original ZIP custody branch](https://github.com/jyqj/codecortex/tree/evidence/p8-originals-oracle-eded-a217-20261009) preserves the complete original artifact, job log, restoration hashes and all cost records. The original formatter failure, its later repair and the correction of an unsupported metadata capture timestamp remain explicit history.

[The current public source-admission archive](https://github.com/jyqj/codecortex/tree/e5d381667d19922b006f45075fc077f8a73197c3/artifacts/checkpoints) contains the prior fixed reviews and execution receipts; the newly completed ordinary CI log is being appended separately.

No full 150/1500 matrix, workload speedup, release approval or original TODO completion is claimed here. Original task ledger remains **192 total / 163 done / 29 remaining / 0 newly completed**.

Borrow SQLite row text during exact canonical JSON projection to remove temporary owned text copies. Preserve the original field ordering, duplicate-column result, real-number encoding, escaped-byte budgets and error order.

This remains a Draft against the fixed review base `fffd950d5b34b0180f308db1428a57d5bf358bf1`. Current head is **`9ddae045f6925140a4d652c5f28f64add459eff1`**, a formatter-only successor of the original cost-study source.

## Actual correctness verification

All three jobs in [ordinary CI run 37961137036](https://github.com/jyqj/codecortex/actions/runs/37961137036) passed; the [main check](https://github.com/jyqj/codecortex/actions/runs/37961137036/job/113923960385) finished at **2026-10-09 17:48:54 UTC**. Its complete original log and independent review are retained. The actual PR test-merge tree exactly equals the reviewed head tree `20ae2605cad47e1b56c80e5f83278bbd34744982`.

Formatting, Clippy, all-target compilation, authorized regressions and the original source/task guards passed. Each of the four new controls actually passed in both default and eval-http executions:

- Reordered and duplicate columns produce the original bytes.
- Escaped byte lengths preserve row-boundary budgets.
- SELECT errors retain their order and subsequent recovery behavior.
- Real values retain the original Value encoding.

The finite ignored cost probe remained ignored in these ordinary regression executions.

## Cost observations and adoption decision

**Default adoption remains on hold.** The original cost study is [run 37956976406](https://github.com/jyqj/codecortex/actions/runs/37956976406), source **`eded24951c3e99693410ce959a627ab575f66bec`**. It retains all **100 measurements: five cases × 20 alternating-order pairs**, with complete byte assertions. No observations were trimmed.

The four smaller/blob cases were faster in all 20 pairs. The `multiple_text` case had median paired borrowed/original ratio **1.0664289** and was faster in only 10/20 pairs. Ordering matters: its medians were 1.2050854 with original-first and 0.9557795 with borrowed-first. The first side's result vector also remained live while the second side was timed. These observations do not establish an end-to-end parity or indexing improvement.

A separately prepared equal-lifetime candidate remains an untriggered, archived alternative. Its code and prospective measurements are not credited to this PR or the original study.

## Preserved evidence and scope

The [original ZIP custody branch](https://github.com/jyqj/codecortex/tree/evidence/p8-originals-oracle-eded-a217-20261009) preserves the complete original artifact, job log, restoration hashes and all cost records. The original formatter failure, its later repair and the correction of an unsupported metadata capture timestamp remain explicit history.

[The current public source-admission archive](https://github.com/jyqj/codecortex/tree/e5d381667d19922b006f45075fc077f8a73197c3/artifacts/checkpoints) contains the prior fixed reviews and execution receipts; the newly completed ordinary CI log is being appended separately.

[{"sha":"8783b06e765ce32386def8f567393fdb82a4dc10","filename":".github/workflows/p8-oracle-serialization-cost.yml","status":"added","additions":242,"deletions":0,"changes":242,"blob_url":"https://github.com/jyqj/codecortex/blob/9ddae045f6925140a4d652c5f28f64add459eff1/.github%2Fworkflows%2Fp8-oracle-serialization-cost.yml","raw_url":"https://github.com/jyqj/codecortex/raw/9ddae045f6925140a4d652c5f28f64add459eff1/.github%2Fworkflows%2Fp8-oracle-serialization-cost.yml","contents_url":"https://api.github.com/repos/jyqj/codecortex/contents/.github%2Fworkflows%2Fp8-oracle-serialization-cost.yml?ref=9ddae045f6925140a4d652c5f28f64add459eff1","patch":"@@ -0,0 +1,242 @@
+name: P8 oracle serialization cost observation
+
+on:
+  workflow_dispatch:
+  pull_request:
+    types: [labeled]
+
+permissions:
+  contents: read
+
+defaults:
+  run:
+    shell: bash
+
+env:
+  CARGO_TERM_COLOR: never
+  CARGO_INCREMENTAL: '0'
+  CARGO_BUILD_JOBS: '2'
+  RUSTFLAGS: ''
+  CARGO_ENCODED_RUSTFLAGS: ''
+  PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE: '1'
+  P8_COST_EXPECTED_HEAD: ${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha || github.sha }}
+  P8_COST_TEST: benchmark::oracle::projection_tests::borrowed_serialization_release_cost_probe
+
+jobs:
+  observe:
+    if: github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch' || github.event.label.name == 'p8-oracle-cost-run'
+    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
+    timeout-minutes: 90
+    steps:
+      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
+        with:
+          ref: ${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha || github.sha }}
+          sparse-checkout-cone-mode: false
+          sparse-checkout: |
+            /*
+            !/artifacts/
+      - name: Prepare original output directory
+        run: |
+          mkdir "$RUNNER_TEMP/p8-oracle-cost"
+          printf 'P8_COST_OUTPUT=%s/p8-oracle-cost\n' "$RUNNER_TEMP" >> "$GITHUB_ENV"
+          printf 'CARGO_TARGET_DIR=%s/p8-oracle-cost-target\n' "$RUNNER_TEMP" >> "$GITHUB_ENV"
+      - uses: dtolnay/rust-toolchain@1.95.0
+      - name: Bind actual source, compiler and probe command
+        run: |
+          python3 -B - <<'PY'
+          import hashlib
+          import json
+          import os
+          from pathlib import Path
+          import subprocess
+          import sys
+          from datetime import datetime, timezone
+
+          root = Path(os.environ['GITHUB_WORKSPACE'])
+          out = Path(os.environ['P8_COST_OUTPUT'])
+          sys.path.insert(0, str(root / 'scripts'))
+          from p7_build_identity import source_snapshot
+
+          source = source_snapshot(root)
+          assert source['source_commit'] == os.environ['P8_COST_EXPECTED_HEAD']
+          observers = {}
+          for path in ('scripts/p7_build_identity.py', '.github/workflows/p8-oracle-serialization-cost.yml'):
+              original = subprocess.check_output(['git', 'show', 'HEAD:' + path], cwd=root)
+              live = (root / path).read_bytes()
+              assert live == original, path
+              observers[path] = hashlib.sha256(live).hexdigest()
+          (out / 'source-before.json').write_text(json.dumps(source, indent=2, sort_keys=True) + '\n')
+          (out / 'Cargo.lock').write_bytes((root / 'Cargo.lock').read_bytes())
+          compiler = {}
+          for name, command in [('rustc', ['rustc', '-vV']), ('cargo', ['cargo', '-Vv'])]:
+              value = subprocess.check_output(command, stderr=subprocess.STDOUT)
+              (out / (name + '-before.txt')).write_bytes(value)
+              compiler[name] = hashlib.sha256(value).hexdigest()
+          argv = ['cargo', 'test', '--release', '--locked', '--message-format=json', '-p', 'cc-eval', '--lib',
+                  os.environ['P8_COST_TEST'], '--', '--exact', '--ignored', '--nocapture', '--test-threads=1']
+          receipt = {'schema': 'p8-oracle-serialization-cost-observation-v1',
+                     'created_utc': datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(),
+                     'run_id': os.environ['GITHUB_RUN_ID'], 'run_attempt': os.environ['GITHUB_RUN_ATTEMPT'],
+                     'expected_source': os.environ['P8_COST_EXPECTED_HEAD'],
+                     'source_commit': source['source_commit'], 'source_tree': source['source_tree'],
+                     'Cargo_lock_sha256': hashlib.sha256((root / 'Cargo.lock').read_bytes()).hexdigest(),
+                     'observer_inputs': observers, 'toolchain_output_sha256': compiler, 'argv': argv,
+                     'environment': {key: os.environ.get(key) for key in
+                         ('CARGO_INCREMENTAL', 'CARGO_BUILD_JOBS', 'CARGO_TARGET_DIR', 'RUSTFLAGS',
+                          'CARGO_ENCODED_RUSTFLAGS', 'RUSTUP_TOOLCHAIN', 'TMPDIR', 'TMP', 'TEMP')},
+                     'scope': 'Finite release serialization cost observation; not a scale sample or TODO acceptance gate.'}
+          (out / 'identity-before.json').write_text(json.dumps(receipt, indent=2, sort_keys=True) + '\n')
+          PY
+      - name: Observe the original finite ignored probe and retain both streams
+        run: |
+          python3 -B - <<'PY'
+          import json
+          import os
+          from pathlib import Path
+          import subprocess
+          import sys
+          import time
+          from datetime import datetime, timezone
+
+          out = Path(os.environ['P8_COST_OUTPUT'])
+          identity = json.loads((out / 'identity-before.json').read_text())
+          started = datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat()
+          begin = time.monotonic_ns()
+          code = None
+          error = None
+          try:
+              with (out / 'probe.stdout').open('wb') as stdout, (out / 'probe.stderr').open('wb') as stderr:
+                  code = subprocess.run(identity['argv'], cwd=os.environ['GITHUB_WORKSPACE'],
+                                        stdout=stdout, stderr=stderr, check=False).returncode
+          except BaseException as exc:
+              error = type(exc).__name__ + ': ' + str(exc)
+              raise
+          finally:
+              receipt = {'started_utc': started, 'finished_utc': datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(),
+                         'wall_ns': time.monotonic_ns() - begin, 'exit_code': code, 'launch_error': error,
+                         'argv': identity['argv'], 'scope': 'Includes compilation; per-round serialization times are in the original probe stdout.'}
+              (out / 'execution.json').write_text(json.dumps(receipt, indent=2, sort_keys=True) + '\n')
+              for name, stream in [('probe.stdout', sys.stdout.buffer), ('probe.stderr', sys.stderr.buffer)]:
+                  path = out / name
+                  if path.exists():
+                      with path.open('rb') as source:
+                          for block in iter(lambda: source.read(1024 * 1024), b''):
+                              stream.write(block)
+                      stream.flush()
+          sys.exit(code)
+          PY
+      - name: Preserve after-source identity and original file hashes even on failure
+        if: always()
+        run: |
+          python3 -B - <<'PY'
+          import hashlib
+          import json
+          import os
+          from pathlib import Path
+          import re
+          import subprocess
+          import sys
+
+          def observe_cost_output(out, root, target):
+              records, binaries, finishes = [], [], []
+              execution = json.loads((out / 'execution.json').read_text())
+              assert execution['exit_code'] == 0 and execution['launch_error'] is None
+              raw = (out / 'probe.stdout').read_text()
+              for line in raw.splitlines():
+                  start = line.find('{')
+                  if start < 0:
+                      continue
+                  try:
+                      # libtest may prefix its first probe object with the test name.
+                      value, end = json.JSONDecoder().raw_decode(line[start:])
+                  except json.JSONDecodeError:
+                      continue
+                  if not isinstance(value, dict):
+                      continue
+                  if value.get('schema') == 'p8-oracle-serialization-cost-v1':
+                      assert not line[start + end:].strip(), 'trailing probe output'
+                      records.append(value)
+                  elif start == 0:
+                      if value.get('reason') == 'build-finished':
+                          finishes.append(value)
+                      if (value.get('reason') == 'compiler-artifact'
+                              and value.get('target', {}).get('name') == 'cc_eval'
+                              and value.get('target', {}).get('kind') == ['lib']
+                              and value.get('profile', {}).get('test') is True
+                              and value.get('executable')):
+                          binaries.append(value)
+              expected = {(case, round_) for case in
+                  ('multiple_text', 'short_fields', 'blob', 'empty_text', 'null') for round_ in range(20)}
+              slots = []
+              for value in records:
+                  assert type(value.get('round')) is int and type(value.get('rows')) is int
+                  assert value['rows'] == 256
+                  slots.append((value['case'], value['round']))
+                  assert value['first'] == ('original' if value['round'] % 2 == 0 else 'borrowed')
+                  assert all(isinstance(value.get(key), str) and re.fullmatch(r'[0-9]+', value[key])
+                             for key in ('original_ns', 'borrowed_ns'))
+                  assert re.fullmatch(r'[0-9a-f]{64}', value['original_digest'])
+                  assert value['original_digest'] == value['borrowed_digest']
+              assert len(slots) == 100 and len(set(slots)) == 100 and set(slots) == expected
+              assert re.search(r'test result: ok\. 1 passed; 0 failed; 0 ignored;', raw)
+              assert finishes == [{'reason': 'build-finished', 'success': True}]
+              assert len(binaries) == 1
+              binary = binaries[0]
+              assert binary['package_id'].rpartition('#')[0].endswith('/cc-eval')
+              assert Path(binary['manifest_path']).resolve() == root / 'crates/cc-eval/Cargo.toml'
+              assert Path(binary['target']['src_path']).resolve() == root / 'crates/cc-eval/src/lib.rs'
+              assert binary['features'] == ['default'] and binary['fresh'] is False
+              assert binary['profile']['opt_level'] == '3' and binary['profile']['debug_assertions'] is False
+              executable = Path(binary['executable']).resolve(strict=True)
+              assert executable.is_file() and executable.is_relative_to(target.resolve())
+              digest = hashlib.sha256()
+              with executable.open('rb') as source:
+                  for block in iter(lambda: source.read(1024 * 1024), b''):
+                      digest.update(block)
+              return {'schema': 'p8-oracle-serialization-cost-observation-v1', 'status': 'observed',
+                      'records': records, 'record_count': 100, 'compiler_artifact': binary,
+                      'test_executable_sha256': digest.hexdigest(), 'test_executable_bytes': executable.stat().st_size,
+                      'scope': 'Finite local mechanism cost only; no timing threshold or scale/TODO acceptance.'}
+
+          root = Path(os.environ['GITHUB_WORKSPACE'])
+          out = Path(os.environ['P8_COST_OUTPUT'])
+          out.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
+          sys.path.insert(0, str(root / 'scripts'))
+          receipt = {'source_unchanged': False, 'observer_inputs_unchanged': False,
+                     'toolchain_outputs_unchanged': False, 'error': None}
+          try:
+              from p7_build_identity import source_snapshot

+"""Finite controls for the actual inline JSON observer, never native execution."""
+import ast
+import copy
+import hashlib
+import json
+from pathlib import Path
+import re
+import tempfile
+
+import yaml
+
+ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
+WORKFLOW = ROOT / '.github/workflows/p8-oracle-serialization-cost.yml'
+document = yaml.safe_load(WORKFLOW.read_text())
+blocks = []
+for step in document['jobs']['observe']['steps']:
+    value = step.get('run', '')
+    if value.startswith("python3 -B - <<'PY'\n"):
+        body = value.split('\n', 1)[1].rsplit('\nPY', 1)[0]
+        ast.parse(body)
+        blocks.append(body)
+assert len(blocks) == 3
+assert 'runner.' not in json.dumps(document['env'])
+node = next(n for n in ast.parse(blocks[2]).body
+            if isinstance(n, ast.FunctionDef) and n.name == 'observe_cost_output')
+namespace = {'json': json, 'Path': Path, 're': re, 'hashlib': hashlib}
+exec(compile(ast.Module(body=[node], type_ignores=[]), str(WORKFLOW), 'exec'), namespace)
+results = []
+with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix='oracle-cost-observer-controls-') as directory:
+    out, source, target = [Path(directory) / name for name in ('out', 'source', 'target')]
+    for path in (out, source, target):
+        path.mkdir()
+    executable = target / 'probe'
+    executable.write_bytes(b'Synthetic identity only; this file is never executed.\n')
+    artifact = {
+        'reason': 'compiler-artifact',
+        'target': {'name': 'cc_eval', 'kind': ['lib'], 'src_path': str(source / 'crates/cc-eval/src/lib.rs')},
+        'profile': {'test': True, 'opt_level': '3', 'debug_assertions': False},
+        'executable': str(executable), 'package_id': 'path+file://' + str(source) + '/crates/cc-eval#1.0.0',
+        'manifest_path': str(source / 'crates/cc-eval/Cargo.toml'), 'features': ['default'], 'fresh': False,
+    }
+    records = [dict(schema='p8-oracle-serialization-cost-v1', case=case, round=i, rows=256,
+                    first='original' if i % 2 == 0 else 'borrowed', original_ns='100', borrowed_ns='101',
+                    original_digest='a' * 64, borrowed_digest='a' * 64)
+               for case in ('multiple_text', 'short_fields', 'blob', 'empty_text', 'null') for i in range(20)]
+    for case in ('complete_prefix', 'compiler_warning_quotes_schema', 'zero_tests', 'missing_slot',
+                 'duplicate_slot', 'digest_change', 'wrong_producer', 'failed_process', 'wrong_default_feature'):
+        values, event = copy.deepcopy(records), copy.deepcopy(artifact)
+        if case == 'zero_tests': values = []
+        if case == 'missing_slot': values.pop()
+        if case == 'duplicate_slot': values[-1] = copy.deepcopy(values[0])
+        if case == 'digest_change': values[33]['borrowed_digest'] = 'b' * 64
+        if case == 'wrong_producer': event['manifest_path'] = str(source / 'wrong/Cargo.toml')
+        if case == 'wrong_default_feature': event['features'] = []
+        lines = [json.dumps(event), json.dumps({'reason': 'build-finished', 'success': True})]
+        if case == 'compiler_warning_quotes_schema':
+            lines.append(json.dumps({'reason': 'compiler-message', 'message': {
+                'message': 'quoted p8-oracle-serialization-cost-v1 in a compiler diagnostic'}}))
+        lines += [('test benchmark::oracle::projection_tests::borrowed_serialization_release_cost_probe ... '
+                   if i == 0 else '') + json.dumps(value) for i, value in enumerate(values)]
+        count = '0' if case == 'zero_tests' else '1'
+        lines.append('test result: ok. ' + count + ' passed; 0 failed; 0 ignored; 23 filtered out; finished in 0.01s')
+        (out / 'probe.stdout').write_text('\n'.join(lines) + '\n')
+        (out / 'execution.json').write_text(json.dumps({'exit_code': 1 if case == 'failed_process' else 0,
+                                                       'launch_error': None}))
+        try:
+            namespace['observe_cost_output'](out, source, target)
+            accepted, error = True, None
+        except Exception as exc:
+            accepted, error = False, type(exc).__name__
+        assert accepted == (case in ('complete_prefix', 'compiler_warning_quotes_schema')), case
+        results.append({'case': case, 'accepted': accepted, 'error_type': error, 'expected_result_observed': True})
+data = WORKFLOW.read_bytes()
+receipt = {'scope': 'Actual inline observer AST on synthetic Cargo/probe text. No Rust, Actions, native workload, or scale replay.',
+           'workflow': {'path': str(WORKFLOW), 'bytes': len(data), 'sha256': hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest(),
+                        'git_blob': hashlib.sha1(b'blob ' + str(len(data)).encode() + b'\0' + data).hexdigest()},
+           'control_script_sha256': hashlib.sha256(Path(__file__).read_bytes()).hexdigest(),
+           'yaml_parse': True, 'python_AST_blocks': len(blocks), 'controls': results}
+target = ROOT / 'workflow-v3-static-and-output-controls.json'
+assert not target.exists()
+target.write_text(json.dumps(receipt, indent=2) + '\n')
+print(json.dumps(receipt, indent=2))"},{"sha":"6fe83ace0fe9d517251f6227f9ab701d9ff29a05","filename":"artifacts/checkpoints/p8-oracle-borrowing-source-a217-20261009/combined-candidate-manifest.json","status":"added","additions":69,"deletions":0,"changes":69,"blob_url":"https://github.com/jyqj/codecortex/blob/9ddae045f6925140a4d652c5f28f64add459eff1/artifacts%2Fcheckpoints%2Fp8-oracle-borrowing-source-a217-20261009%2Fcombined-candidate-manifest.json","raw_url":"https://github.com/jyqj/codecortex/raw/9ddae045f6925140a4d652c5f28f64add459eff1/artifacts%2Fcheckpoints%2Fp8-oracle-borrowing-source-a217-20261009%2Fcombined-candidate-manifest.json","contents_url":"https://api.github.com/repos/jyqj/codecortex/contents/artifacts%2Fcheckpoints%2Fp8-oracle-borrowing-source-a217-20261009%2Fcombined-candidate-manifest.json?ref=9ddae045f6925140a4d652c5f28f64add459eff1","patch":"@@ -0,0 +1,69 @@

+            ],
+        ];
+        let mut statement = conn.prepare("SELECT ?1, ?2, ?3, ?4, ?5").unwrap();
+        for layout in layouts {
+            let cols: Vec<String> = layout.into_iter().map(String::from).collect();
+            let mut projection = RowProjection::new(&cols);
+            for values in &cases {
+                let mut rows = statement.query(rusqlite::params_from_iter(values)).unwrap();
+                let row = rows.next().unwrap().unwrap();
+                let expected = serde_json::to_string(&project_row(row, &cols).unwrap()).unwrap();
+                assert_eq!(projection.serialize_row(row).unwrap(), expected);
+                assert_eq!(projection.serialize_row(row).unwrap(), expected);
+                assert!(projection.values.values().all(Value::is_null));
+            }
+        }
+    }
+
+    #[test]
+    fn borrowed_projection_uses_original_value_real_encoding() {
+        for value in [
+            f64::NAN,
+            f64::INFINITY,
+            f64::NEG_INFINITY,
+            -0.0,
+            0.0,
+            f64::MIN_POSITIVE,
+            f64::from_bits(1),
+            f64::MAX,
+            1.2345678901234567,
+        ] {
+            let original = json!(value);
+            let borrowed = ProjectedCell::Scalar(json!(value));
+            assert_eq!(
+                serde_json::to_string(&borrowed).unwrap(),
+                serde_json::to_string(&original).unwrap()
+            );
+        }
+    }
+
+    #[test]
+    fn borrowed_projection_preserves_select_error_order_and_recovers() {
+        let conn = Connection::open_in_memory().unwrap();
+        let cols = vec!["z".into(), "a".into(), "z".into()];
+        let mut projection = RowProjection::new(&cols);
+        for sql in [
+            "SELECT CAST(x'80' AS TEXT), 'ok', 'overwrites-invalid-text'",
+            "SELECT 1, CAST(x'80' AS TEXT)",
+            "SELECT 1, 2",
+        ] {
+            let mut statement = conn.prepare(sql).unwrap();
+            let mut rows = statement.query([]).unwrap();
+            let row = rows.next().unwrap().unwrap();
+            let original_error = project_row(row, &cols).unwrap_err().to_string();
+            assert_eq!(
+                projection.serialize_row(row).unwrap_err().to_string(),
+                original_error
+            );
+            assert!(projection.values.values().all(Value::is_null));
+            let actual = conn
+                .query_row("SELECT 'old', NULL, 'last'", [], |row| {
+                    let expected =
+                        serde_json::to_string(&project_row(row, &cols).unwrap()).unwrap();
+                    let actual = projection.serialize_row(row).unwrap();
+                    assert_eq!(actual, expected);
+                    Ok(actual)
+                })
+                .unwrap();
+            let expected: Value = json!({"z": "last", "a": null});
+            assert_eq!(actual, serde_json::to_string(&expected).unwrap());
+        }
+    }
+
+    #[test]
+    fn borrowed_projection_preserves_escaped_byte_lengths_at_row_boundaries() {
+        let conn = Connection::open_in_memory().unwrap();
+        let cols = vec!["payload".into()];
+        let mut projection = RowProjection::new(&cols);
+        let mut statement = conn.prepare("SELECT ?1").unwrap();
+        for limit in [128, 65_536, 1_048_576] {
+            for offset in [-1_isize, 0, 1] {
+                // The compact JSON wrapper {"payload":""} is fourteen bytes.
+                let text = "x".repeat((limit as isize + offset - 14) as usize);
+                let mut rows = statement.query([&text]).unwrap();
+                let row = rows.next().unwrap().unwrap();
+                let expected = serde_json::to_string(&project_row(row, &cols).unwrap()).unwrap();
+                let actual = projection.serialize_row(row).unwrap();
+                assert_eq!(actual, expected);
+                assert_eq!(actual.len(), (limit as isize + offset) as usize);
+                assert_eq!(actual.len() > limit, offset > 0);
+            }
+        }
+        let escaped = "\0\n\t\"\\é".repeat(256);
+        let mut rows = statement.query([&escaped]).unwrap();
+        let row = rows.next().unwrap().unwrap();
+        let expected = serde_json::to_string(&project_row(row, &cols).unwrap()).unwrap();
+        let actual = projection.serialize_row(row).unwrap();
+        assert_eq!(actual.as_bytes(), expected.as_bytes());
+        assert!(actual.len() > escaped.len());
+    }
+
+    // Exact pre-change streaming baseline: keep its Map across rows instead
+    // of substituting the slower, per-row project_row diagnostic API.
+    fn original_serialize_row(
+        projection: &mut RowProjection<'_>,
+        row: &rusqlite::Row<'_>,
+    ) -> Result<String> {
+        projection.project(row)?;
+        let serialized: Result<String> =
+            serde_json::to_string(&projection.values).map_err(Into::into);
+        projection.clear_values();
+        serialized
+    }
+
+    #[test]
+    #[ignore = "explicit finite release cost observation; no timing acceptance threshold"]
+    fn borrowed_serialization_release_cost_probe() {
+        use rusqlite::types::Value as SqlValue;
+        use std::time::Instant;
+
+        fn collect(
+            statement: &mut rusqlite::Statement<'_>,
+            projection: &mut RowProjection<'_>,
+            borrowed: bool,
+        ) -> (Vec<String>, u128) {
+            let started = Instant::now();
+            let mut rows = statement.query([]).unwrap();
+            let mut output = Vec::new();
+            while let Some(row) = rows.next().unwrap() {
+                output.push(if borrowed {
+                    projection.serialize_row(row).unwrap()
+                } else {
+                    original_serialize_row(projection, row).unwrap()
+                });
+            }
+            (output, started.elapsed().as_nanos())
+        }
+
+        let cases = [
+            (
+                "multiple_text",
+                vec![
+                    SqlValue::Text("é/中文\n\"\\".repeat(512)),
+                    SqlValue::Text("manifest-payload".repeat(256)),
+                    SqlValue::Text("qualified::name".repeat(128)),
+                    SqlValue::Text("path/to/source.rs".repeat(128)),
+                    SqlValue::Integer(17),
+                    SqlValue::Null,
+                ],
+            ),
+            (
+                "short_fields",
+                vec![
+                    SqlValue::Text("a".into()),
+                    SqlValue::Text("bc".into()),
+                    SqlValue::Integer(i64::MIN),
+                    SqlValue::Integer(i64::MAX),
+                    SqlValue::Real(-0.0),
+                    SqlValue::Real(1.25),
+                ],
+            ),
+            (
+                "blob",
+                vec![
+                    SqlValue::Blob([0, 255, 128, 1].repeat(1024)),
+                    SqlValue::Blob(Vec::new()),
+                    SqlValue::Text("blob-name".into()),
+                    SqlValue::Integer(4),
+                    SqlValue::Null,
+                    SqlValue::Real(0.0),
+                ],
+            ),
+            ("empty_text", vec![SqlValue::Text(String::new()); 6]),
+            ("null", vec![SqlValue::Null; 6]),
+        ];
+        let cols: Vec<String> = ["z", "a", "payload", "path", "ordinal", "empty"]
+            .into_iter()
+            .map(String::from)
+            .collect();
+        for (case, values) in cases {
+            let conn = Connection::open_in_memory().unwrap();
+            conn.execute_batch("CREATE TABLE sample(c0,c1,c2,c3,c4,c5)")
+                .unwrap();
+            for _ in 0..256 {
+                conn.execute(
+                    "INSERT INTO sample VALUES(?1,?2,?3,?4,?5,?6)",
+                    rusqlite::params_from_iter(&values),
+                )
+                .unwrap();
+            }
+            let mut statement = conn
+                .prepare("SELECT c0,c1,c2,c3,c4,c5 FROM sample ORDER BY rowid")
+                .unwrap();
+            let mut original = RowProjection::new(&cols);
+            let mut borrowed = RowProjection::new(&cols);
+            let (warm_original, _) = collect(&mut statement, &mut original, false);
+            let (warm_borrowed, _) = collect(&mut statement, &mut borrowed, true);
+            assert_eq!(warm_original, warm_borrowed);
+            drop((warm_original, warm_borrowed));
+            for round in 0..20 {
+                let ((expected, original_ns), (actual, borrowed_ns)) = if round % 2 == 0 {
+                    (
+                        collect(&mut statement, &mut original, false),
+                        collect(&mut statement, &mut borrowed, true),
+                    )
+                } else {
+                    let actual = collect(&mut statement, &mut borrowed, true);
+                    let expected = collect(&mut statement, &mut original, false);
+                    (expected, actual)
+                };
+                assert_eq!(actual, expected);
+                assert_eq!(actual.len(), 256);
+                let original_digest = manifest::digest(&serde_json::to_vec(&expected).unwrap());
+                let borrowed_digest = manifest::digest(&serde_json::to_vec(&actual).unwrap());
+                assert_eq!(original_digest, borrowed_digest);
+                println!(
+                    "{}",
+                    json!({
+                        "schema": "p8-oracle-serialization-cost-v1",
+                        "case": case,
+                        "round": round,
+                        "first": if round % 2 == 0 { "original" } else { "borrowed" },
+                        "rows": actual.len(),
+                        "canonical_bytes": actual.iter().map(String::len).sum::<usize>(),
+                        "original_ns": original_ns.to_string(),
+                        "borrowed_ns": borrowed_ns.to_string(),
+                        "original_digest": original_digest,
+                        "borrowed_digest": borrowed_digest,
+                        "timing_scope": "same SQLite SELECT traversal plus row serialization and output retention",
+                        "timing_threshold": null,
+                        "original_streaming_source_blob": "4c7fdb879e039af164b3b10ea1491d538c69ac68"
+                    })
+                );
+            }
+        }
+    }
 }"},{"sha":"877d12eee20b2afb0ae0ba3ddf1fadbdc7af0c9b","filename":"scripts/reviewed-source-registry-v15.json","status":"modified","additions":6,"deletions":5,"changes":11,"blob_url":"https://github.com/jyqj/codecortex/blob/9ddae045f6925140a4d652c5f28f64add459eff1/scripts%2Freviewed-source-registry-v15.json","raw_url":"https://github.com/jyqj/codecortex/raw/9ddae045f6925140a4d652c5f28f64add459eff1/scripts%2Freviewed-source-registry-v15.json","contents_url":"https://api.github.com/repos/jyqj/codecortex/contents/scripts%2Freviewed-source-registry-v15.json?ref=9ddae045f6925140a4d652c5f28f64add459eff1","patch":"@@ -563,7 +563,7 @@

[{"sha":"8783b06e765ce32386def8f567393fdb82a4dc10","filename":".github/workflows/p8-oracle-serialization-cost.yml","status":"added","additions":242,"deletions":0,"changes":242,"blob_url":"https://github.com/jyqj/codecortex/blob/9ddae045f6925140a4d652c5f28f64add459eff1/.github%2Fworkflows%2Fp8-oracle-serialization-cost.yml","raw_url":"https://github.com/jyqj/codecortex/raw/9ddae045f6925140a4d652c5f28f64add459eff1/.github%2Fworkflows%2Fp8-oracle-serialization-cost.yml","contents_url":"https://api.github.com/repos/jyqj/codecortex/contents/.github%2Fworkflows%2Fp8-oracle-serialization-cost.yml?ref=9ddae045f6925140a4d652c5f28f64add459eff1","patch":"@@ -0,0 +1,242 @@
+name: P8 oracle serialization cost observation
+
+on:
+  workflow_dispatch:
+  pull_request:
+    types: [labeled]
+
+permissions:
+  contents: read
+
+defaults:
+  run:
+    shell: bash
+
+env:
+  CARGO_TERM_COLOR: never
+  CARGO_INCREMENTAL: '0'
+  CARGO_BUILD_JOBS: '2'
+  RUSTFLAGS: ''
+  CARGO_ENCODED_RUSTFLAGS: ''
+  PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE: '1'
+  P8_COST_EXPECTED_HEAD: ${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha || github.sha }}
+  P8_COST_TEST: benchmark::oracle::projection_tests::borrowed_serialization_release_cost_probe
+
+jobs:
+  observe:
+    if: github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch' || github.event.label.name == 'p8-oracle-cost-run'
+    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
+    timeout-minutes: 90
+    steps:
+      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
+        with:
+          ref: ${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha || github.sha }}
+          sparse-checkout-cone-mode: false
+          sparse-checkout: |
+            /*
+            !/artifacts/
+      - name: Prepare original output directory
+        run: |
+          mkdir "$RUNNER_TEMP/p8-oracle-cost"
+          printf 'P8_COST_OUTPUT=%s/p8-oracle-cost\n' "$RUNNER_TEMP" >> "$GITHUB_ENV"
+          printf 'CARGO_TARGET_DIR=%s/p8-oracle-cost-target\n' "$RUNNER_TEMP" >> "$GITHUB_ENV"
+      - uses: dtolnay/rust-toolchain@1.95.0
+      - name: Bind actual source, compiler and probe command
+        run: |
+          python3 -B - <<'PY'
+          import hashlib
+          import json
+          import os
+          from pathlib import Path
+          import subprocess
+          import sys
+          from datetime import datetime, timezone
+
+          root = Path(os.environ['GITHUB_WORKSPACE'])
+          out = Path(os.environ['P8_COST_OUTPUT'])
+          sys.path.insert(0, str(root / 'scripts'))
+          from p7_build_identity import source_snapshot
+
+          source = source_snapshot(root)
+          assert source['source_commit'] == os.environ['P8_COST_EXPECTED_HEAD']
+          observers = {}
+          for path in ('scripts/p7_build_identity.py', '.github/workflows/p8-oracle-serialization-cost.yml'):
+              original = subprocess.check_output(['git', 'show', 'HEAD:' + path], cwd=root)
+              live = (root / path).read_bytes()
+              assert live == original, path
+              observers[path] = hashlib.sha256(live).hexdigest()
+          (out / 'source-before.json').write_text(json.dumps(source, indent=2, sort_keys=True) + '\n')
+          (out / 'Cargo.lock').write_bytes((root / 'Cargo.lock').read_bytes())
+          compiler = {}
+          for name, command in [('rustc', ['rustc', '-vV']), ('cargo', ['cargo', '-Vv'])]:
+              value = subprocess.check_output(command, stderr=subprocess.STDOUT)
+              (out / (name + '-before.txt')).write_bytes(value)
+              compiler[name] = hashlib.sha256(value).hexdigest()
+          argv = ['cargo', 'test', '--release', '--locked', '--message-format=json', '-p', 'cc-eval', '--lib',
+                  os.environ['P8_COST_TEST'], '--', '--exact', '--ignored', '--nocapture', '--test-threads=1']
+          receipt = {'schema': 'p8-oracle-serialization-cost-observation-v1',
+                     'created_utc': datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(),
+                     'run_id': os.environ['GITHUB_RUN_ID'], 'run_attempt': os.environ['GITHUB_RUN_ATTEMPT'],
+                     'expected_source': os.environ['P8_COST_EXPECTED_HEAD'],
+                     'source_commit': source['source_commit'], 'source_tree': source['source_tree'],
+                     'Cargo_lock_sha256': hashlib.sha256((root / 'Cargo.lock').read_bytes()).hexdigest(),
+                     'observer_inputs': observers, 'toolchain_output_sha256': compiler, 'argv': argv,
+                     'environment': {key: os.environ.get(key) for key in
+                         ('CARGO_INCREMENTAL', 'CARGO_BUILD_JOBS', 'CARGO_TARGET_DIR', 'RUSTFLAGS',
+                          'CARGO_ENCODED_RUSTFLAGS', 'RUSTUP_TOOLCHAIN', 'TMPDIR', 'TMP', 'TEMP')},
+                     'scope': 'Finite release serialization cost observation; not a scale sample or TODO acceptance gate.'}
+          (out / 'identity-before.json').write_text(json.dumps(receipt, indent=2, sort_keys=True) + '\n')
+          PY
+      - name: Observe the original finite ignored probe and retain both streams
+        run: |
+          python3 -B - <<'PY'
+          import json
+          import os
+          from pathlib import Path
+          import subprocess
+          import sys
+          import time
+          from datetime import datetime, timezone
+
+          out = Path(os.environ['P8_COST_OUTPUT'])
+          identity = json.loads((out / 'identity-before.json').read_text())
+          started = datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat()
+          begin = time.monotonic_ns()
+          code = None
+          error = None
+          try:
+              with (out / 'probe.stdout').open('wb') as stdout, (out / 'probe.stderr').open('wb') as stderr:
+                  code = subprocess.run(identity['argv'], cwd=os.environ['GITHUB_WORKSPACE'],
+                                        stdout=stdout, stderr=stderr, check=False).returncode
+          except BaseException as exc:
+              error = type(exc).__name__ + ': ' + str(exc)
+              raise
+          finally:
+              receipt = {'started_utc': started, 'finished_utc': datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(),
+                         'wall_ns': time.monotonic_ns() - begin, 'exit_code': code, 'launch_error': error,
+                         'argv': identity['argv'], 'scope': 'Includes compilation; per-round serialization times are in the original probe stdout.'}
+              (out / 'execution.json').write_text(json.dumps(receipt, indent=2, sort_keys=True) + '\n')
+              for name, stream in [('probe.stdout', sys.stdout.buffer), ('probe.stderr', sys.stderr.buffer)]:
+                  path = out / name
+                  if path.exists():
+                      with path.open('rb') as source:
+                          for block in iter(lambda: source.read(1024 * 1024), b''):
+                              stream.write(block)
+                      stream.flush()
+          sys.exit(code)
+          PY
+      - name: Preserve after-source identity and original file hashes even on failure
+        if: always()

+"""Finite controls for the actual inline JSON observer, never native execution."""
+import ast
+import copy
+import hashlib
+import json
+from pathlib import Path
+import re
+import tempfile
+
+import yaml
+
+ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
+WORKFLOW = ROOT / '.github/workflows/p8-oracle-serialization-cost.yml'
+document = yaml.safe_load(WORKFLOW.read_text())
+blocks = []
+for step in document['jobs']['observe']['steps']:
+    value = step.get('run', '')
+    if value.startswith("python3 -B - <<'PY'\n"):
+        body = value.split('\n', 1)[1].rsplit('\nPY', 1)[0]
+        ast.parse(body)
+        blocks.append(body)
+assert len(blocks) == 3
+assert 'runner.' not in json.dumps(document['env'])
+node = next(n for n in ast.parse(blocks[2]).body
+            if isinstance(n, ast.FunctionDef) and n.name == 'observe_cost_output')
+namespace = {'json': json, 'Path': Path, 're': re, 'hashlib': hashlib}
+exec(compile(ast.Module(body=[node], type_ignores=[]), str(WORKFLOW), 'exec'), namespace)
+results = []
+with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix='oracle-cost-observer-controls-') as directory:
+    out, source, target = [Path(directory) / name for name in ('out', 'source', 'target')]
+    for path in (out, source, target):
+        path.mkdir()
+    executable = target / 'probe'
+    executable.write_bytes(b'Synthetic identity only; this file is never executed.\n')
+    artifact = {
+        'reason': 'compiler-artifact',
+        'target': {'name': 'cc_eval', 'kind': ['lib'], 'src_path': str(source / 'crates/cc-eval/src/lib.rs')},
+        'profile': {'test': True, 'opt_level': '3', 'debug_assertions': False},
+        'executable': str(executable), 'package_id': 'path+file://' + str(source) + '/crates/cc-eval#1.0.0',
+        'manifest_path': str(source / 'crates/cc-eval/Cargo.toml'), 'features': ['default'], 'fresh': False,
+    }
+    records = [dict(schema='p8-oracle-serialization-cost-v1', case=case, round=i, rows=256,
+                    first='original' if i % 2 == 0 else 'borrowed', original_ns='100', borrowed_ns='101',
+                    original_digest='a' * 64, borrowed_digest='a' * 64)
+               for case in ('multiple_text', 'short_fields', 'blob', 'empty_text', 'null') for i in range(20)]
+    for case in ('complete_prefix', 'compiler_warning_quotes_schema', 'zero_tests', 'missing_slot',
+                 'duplicate_slot', 'digest_change', 'wrong_producer', 'failed_process', 'wrong_default_feature'):
+        values, event = copy.deepcopy(records), copy.deepcopy(artifact)
+        if case == 'zero_tests': values = []
+        if case == 'missing_slot': values.pop()
+        if case == 'duplicate_slot': values[-1] = copy.deepcopy(values[0])
+        if case == 'digest_change': values[33]['borrowed_digest'] = 'b' * 64
+        if case == 'wrong_producer': event['manifest_path'] = str(source / 'wrong/Cargo.toml')
+        if case == 'wrong_default_feature': event['features'] = []
+        lines = [json.dumps(event), json.dumps({'reason': 'build-finished', 'success': True})]
+        if case == 'compiler_warning_quotes_schema':
+            lines.append(json.dumps({'reason': 'compiler-message', 'message': {
+                'message': 'quoted p8-oracle-serialization-cost-v1 in a compiler diagnostic'}}))
+        lines += [('test benchmark::oracle::projection_tests::borrowed_serialization_release_cost_probe ... '
+                   if i == 0 else '') + json.dumps(value) for i, value in enumerate(values)]
+        count = '0' if case == 'zero_tests' else '1'
+        lines.append('test result: ok. ' + count + ' passed; 0 failed; 0 ignored; 23 filtered out; finished in 0.01s')
+        (out / 'probe.stdout').write_text('\n'.join(lines) + '\n')
+        (out / 'execution.json').write_text(json.dumps({'exit_code': 1 if case == 'failed_process' else 0,
+                                                       'launch_error': None}))
+        try:
+            namespace['observe_cost_output'](out, source, target)
+            accepted, error = True, None
+        except Exception as exc:
+            accepted, error = False, type(exc).__name__
+        assert accepted == (case in ('complete_prefix', 'compiler_warning_quotes_schema')), case
+        results.append({'case': case, 'accepted': accepted, 'error_type': error, 'expected_result_observed': True})
+data = WORKFLOW.read_bytes()
+receipt = {'scope': 'Actual inline observer AST on synthetic Cargo/probe text. No Rust, Actions, native workload, or scale replay.',
+           'workflow': {'path': str(WORKFLOW), 'bytes': len(data), 'sha256': hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest(),

 };
 use rusqlite::{types::ValueRef, Connection, OpenFlags};
+use serde::{ser::SerializeMap, Serialize, Serializer};
 use serde_json::{json, Value};
 use std::{collections::BTreeMap, path::Path};
 const TABLES: &[&str] = &[
@@ -115,17 +116,56 @@ fn select_columns(cols: &[String]) -> String {
 
 /// One immutable SELECT layout, reused only within one table and input side.
 /// Keys are allocated lazily, after the streaming caller checks the first row's
-/// size. Values are released after serialization; only keys/map nodes survive.
+/// size. Streaming text is borrowed only for the current row. The original
+/// owned projection remains available to the diagnostic Value API.
 struct RowProjection<'a> {
     cols: &'a [String],
     values: serde_json::Map<String, Value>,
+    serialization_order: Option<Vec<usize>>,
+}
+
+enum ProjectedCell<'a> {
+    Scalar(Value),
+    Text(&'a str),
+    BlobDigest(String),
+}
+
+impl Serialize for ProjectedCell<'_> {
+    fn serialize<S: Serializer>(&self, serializer: S) -> std::result::Result<S::Ok, S::Error> {
+        match self {
+            Self::Scalar(value) => value.serialize(serializer),
+            Self::Text(value) => serializer.serialize_str(value),
+            Self::BlobDigest(digest) => {
+                let mut object = serializer.serialize_map(Some(1))?;
+                object.serialize_entry("blob_digest", digest)?;

[{"sha":"3020568b63cdccb6d065ccc1105d4710c2bb0114","filename":".github/workflows/p8-rebuild-chunk-cost.yml","status":"added","additions":247,"deletions":0,"changes":247,"blob_url":"https://github.com/jyqj/codecortex/blob/7da43a80bc00698101de5619dd486a3393a667a3/.github%2Fworkflows%2Fp8-rebuild-chunk-cost.yml","raw_url":"https://github.com/jyqj/codecortex/raw/7da43a80bc00698101de5619dd486a3393a667a3/.github%2Fworkflows%2Fp8-rebuild-chunk-cost.yml","contents_url":"https://api.github.com/repos/jyqj/codecortex/contents/.github%2Fworkflows%2Fp8-rebuild-chunk-cost.yml?ref=7da43a80bc00698101de5619dd486a3393a667a3","patch":"@@ -0,0 +1,247 @@
+name: P8 rebuild chunk statement cost observation
+
+on:
+  workflow_dispatch:
+  pull_request:
+    types: [labeled]
+
+permissions:
+  contents: read
+
+defaults:
+  run:
+    shell: bash
+
+env:
+  CARGO_TERM_COLOR: never
+  CARGO_INCREMENTAL: '0'
+  CARGO_BUILD_JOBS: '2'
+  RUSTFLAGS: ''
+  CARGO_ENCODED_RUSTFLAGS: ''
+  PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE: '1'
+  P8_COST_EXPECTED_HEAD: ${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha || github.sha }}
+  P8_COST_TEST: index_db_write_batch::rebuild_chunk_statement_tests::rebuild_chunk_statements_release_cost_probe
+
+jobs:
+  observe:
+    if: github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch' || github.event.label.name == 'p8-rebuild-chunk-cost-run'
+    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
+    timeout-minutes: 90
+    steps:
+      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
+        with:
+          ref: ${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha || github.sha }}
+          sparse-checkout-cone-mode: false
+          sparse-checkout: |
+            /*
+            !/artifacts/
+      - name: Prepare original output directory
+        run: |
+          mkdir "$RUNNER_TEMP/p8-rebuild-chunk-cost"
+          printf 'P8_COST_OUTPUT=%s/p8-rebuild-chunk-cost\n' "$RUNNER_TEMP" >> "$GITHUB_ENV"
+          printf 'CARGO_TARGET_DIR=%s/p8-rebuild-chunk-cost-target\n' "$RUNNER_TEMP" >> "$GITHUB_ENV"
+      - uses: dtolnay/rust-toolchain@1.95.0
+      - name: Bind actual source, compiler and probe command
+        run: |
+          python3 -B - <<'PY'
+          import hashlib
+          import json
+          import os
+          from pathlib import Path
+          import subprocess
+          import sys
+          from datetime import datetime, timezone
+
+          root = Path(os.environ['GITHUB_WORKSPACE'])
+          out = Path(os.environ['P8_COST_OUTPUT'])
+          sys.path.insert(0, str(root / 'scripts'))
+          from p7_build_identity import source_snapshot
+
+          source = source_snapshot(root)
+          assert source['source_commit'] == os.environ['P8_COST_EXPECTED_HEAD']
+          observers = {}
+          for path in ('scripts/p7_build_identity.py', '.github/workflows/p8-rebuild-chunk-cost.yml'):
+              original = subprocess.check_output(['git', 'show', 'HEAD:' + path], cwd=root)
+              live = (root / path).read_bytes()
+              assert live == original, path
+              observers[path] = hashlib.sha256(live).hexdigest()
+          (out / 'source-before.json').write_text(json.dumps(source, indent=2, sort_keys=True) + '\n')
+          (out / 'Cargo.lock').write_bytes((root / 'Cargo.lock').read_bytes())
+          compiler = {}
+          for name, command in [('rustc', ['rustc', '-vV']), ('cargo', ['cargo', '-Vv'])]:
+              value = subprocess.check_output(command, stderr=subprocess.STDOUT)
+              (out / (name + '-before.txt')).write_bytes(value)
+              compiler[name] = hashlib.sha256(value).hexdigest()
+          argv = ['cargo', 'test', '--release', '--locked', '--message-format=json', '-p', 'cc-db', '--lib',
+                  os.environ['P8_COST_TEST'], '--', '--exact', '--ignored', '--nocapture', '--test-threads=1']
+          receipt = {'schema': 'p8-rebuild-chunk-cost-observation-v1',
+                     'created_utc': datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(),
+                     'run_id': os.environ['GITHUB_RUN_ID'], 'run_attempt': os.environ['GITHUB_RUN_ATTEMPT'],
+                     'expected_source': os.environ['P8_COST_EXPECTED_HEAD'],
+                     'source_commit': source['source_commit'], 'source_tree': source['source_tree'],
+                     'Cargo_lock_sha256': hashlib.sha256((root / 'Cargo.lock').read_bytes()).hexdigest(),
+                     'observer_inputs': observers, 'toolchain_output_sha256': compiler, 'argv': argv,
+                     'environment': {key: os.environ.get(key) for key in
+                         ('CARGO_INCREMENTAL', 'CARGO_BUILD_JOBS', 'CARGO_TARGET_DIR', 'RUSTFLAGS',
+                          'CARGO_ENCODED_RUSTFLAGS', 'RUSTUP_TOOLCHAIN', 'TMPDIR', 'TMP', 'TEMP')},
+                     'scope': 'Finite release chunk-loop cost observation; not a scale sample or TODO acceptance gate.'}
+          (out / 'identity-before.json').write_text(json.dumps(receipt, indent=2, sort_keys=True) + '\n')
+          PY
+      - name: Observe the original finite ignored probe and retain both streams
+        run: |
+          python3 -B - <<'PY'
+          import json
+          import os
+          from pathlib import Path
+          import subprocess
+          import sys
+          import time
+          from datetime import datetime, timezone
+
+          out = Path(os.environ['P8_COST_OUTPUT'])
+          identity = json.loads((out / 'identity-before.json').read_text())
+          started = datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat()
+          begin = time.monotonic_ns()
+          code = None
+          error = None
+          try:
+              with (out / 'probe.stdout').open('wb') as stdout, (out / 'probe.stderr').open('wb') as stderr:
+                  code = subprocess.run(identity['argv'], cwd=os.environ['GITHUB_WORKSPACE'],
+                                        stdout=stdout, stderr=stderr, check=False).returncode
+          except BaseException as exc:
+              error = type(exc).__name__ + ': ' + str(exc)
+              raise
+          finally:
+              receipt = {'started_utc': started, 'finished_utc': datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(),
+                         'wall_ns': time.monotonic_ns() - begin, 'exit_code': code, 'launch_error': error,
+                         'argv': identity['argv'], 'scope': 'Includes compilation; per-round chunk-loop times are in the original probe stdout.'}
+              (out / 'execution.json').write_text(json.dumps(receipt, indent=2, sort_keys=True) + '\n')
+              for name, stream in [('probe.stdout', sys.stdout.buffer), ('probe.stderr', sys.stderr.buffer)]:
+                  path = out / name
+                  if path.exists():
+                      with path.open('rb') as source:
+                          for block in iter(lambda: source.read(1024 * 1024), b''):
+                              stream.write(block)
+                      stream.flush()
+          sys.exit(code)
+          PY
+      - name: Preserve after-source identity and original file hashes even on failure
+        if: always()
+        run: |
+          python3 -B - <<'PY'
+          import hashlib
+          import json
+          import os
+          from pathlib import Path
+          import re
+          import subprocess
+          import sys
+
+          def observe_cost_output(out, root, target):
+              records, binaries, finishes = [], [], []
+              execution = json.loads((out / 'execution.json').read_text())
+              assert execution['exit_code'] == 0 and execution['launch_error'] is None
+              raw = (out / 'probe.stdout').read_text()
+              for line in raw.splitlines():
+                  start = line.find('{')
+                  if start < 0:
+                      continue
+                  try:
+                      # libtest may prefix its first probe object with the test name.
+                      value, end = json.JSONDecoder().raw_decode(line[start:])
+                  except json.JSONDecodeError:
+                      continue
+                  if not isinstance(value, dict):
+                      continue
+                  if value.get('schema') == 'p8-rebuild-chunk-statements-cost-v1':
+                      assert not line[start + end:].strip(), 'trailing probe output'
+                      records.append(value)
+                  elif start == 0:
+                      if value.get('reason') == 'build-finished':
+                          finishes.append(value)
+                      if (value.get('reason') == 'compiler-artifact'
+                              and value.get('target', {}).get('name') == 'cc_db'
+                              and value.get('target', {}).get('kind') == ['lib']
+                              and value.get('profile', {}).get('test') is True
+                              and value.get('executable')):
+                          binaries.append(value)
+              expected = {(case, round_) for case in
+                  ('single_plain', 'short_plain_6', 'mixed_32', 'compressed_64') for round_ in range(20)}
+              counts = {'single_plain': 1, 'short_plain_6': 6, 'mixed_32': 32, 'compressed_64': 64}
+              slots = []
+              for value in records:
+                  assert type(value.get('round')) is int and type(value.get('chunks')) is int
+                  assert value.get('case') in counts and value['chunks'] == counts[value['case']]
+                  for key in ('original_base_rows', 'original_fts_rows', 'retained_base_rows', 'retained_fts_rows'):
+                      assert type(value.get(key)) is int and value[key] == value['chunks']
+                  assert value.get('performance_threshold') is None and 'performance_threshold' in value
+                  assert value.get('timed_scope') == 'chunk-loop including compression selection and both inserts; excludes begin/readback/rollback'
+                  slots.append((value['case'], value['round']))
+                  assert value['first'] == ('original' if value['round'] % 2 == 0 else 'retained')
+                  assert all(isinstance(value.get(key), str) and re.fullmatch(r'[0-9]+', value[key])
+                             for key in ('original_ns', 'retained_ns'))
+                  assert re.fullmatch(r'[0-9a-f]{64}', value['original_typed_rows_debug_blake3'])
+                  assert value['original_typed_rows_debug_blake3'] == value['retained_typed_rows_debug_blake3']
+              assert len(slots) == 80 and len(set(slots)) == 80 and set(slots) == expected
+              assert re.search(r'test result: ok\. 1 passed; 0 failed; 0 ignored;', raw)
+              assert finishes == [{'reason': 'build-finished', 'success': True}]
+              assert len(binaries) == 1
+              binary = binaries[0]
+              assert binary['package_id'].rpartition('#')[0].endswith('/cc-db')
+              assert Path(binary['manifest_path']).resolve() == root / 'crates/cc-db/Cargo.toml'
+              assert Path(binary['target']['src_path']).resolve() == root / 'crates/cc-db/src/lib.rs'
+              assert binary['features'] == [] and binary['fresh'] is False
+              assert binary['profile']['opt_level'] == '3' and binary['profile']['debug_assertions'] is False
+              executable = Path(binary['executable']).resolve(strict=True)
+              assert executable.is_file() and executable.is_relative_to(target.resolve())
+              digest = hashlib.sha256()
+              with executable.open('rb') as source:
+                  for block in iter(lambda: source.read(1024 * 1024), b''):
+                      digest.update(block)
+              return {'schema': 'p8-rebuild-chunk-cost-observation-v1', 'status': 'observed',

+//! Prepared statements cache for faster execution.
+
+use crate::raw_statement::RawStatement;
+use crate::{Connection, PrepFlags, Result, Statement};
+use hashlink::LruCache;
+use std::cell::RefCell;
+use std::ops::{Deref, DerefMut};
+use std::sync::Arc;
+
+impl Connection {
+    /// Prepare a SQL statement for execution, returning a previously prepared
+    /// (but not currently in-use) statement if one is available. The
+    /// returned statement will be cached for reuse by future calls to
+    /// [`prepare_cached`](Connection::prepare_cached) once it is dropped.
+    ///
+    /// ```rust,no_run
+    /// # use rusqlite::{Connection, Result};
+    /// fn insert_new_people(conn: &Connection) -> Result<()> {
+    ///     {
+    ///         let mut stmt = conn.prepare_cached("INSERT INTO People (name) VALUES (?1)")?;
+    ///         stmt.execute(["Joe Smith"])?;
+    ///     }
+    ///     {
+    ///         // This will return the same underlying SQLite statement handle without
+    ///         // having to prepare it again.
+    ///         let mut stmt = conn.prepare_cached("INSERT INTO People (name) VALUES (?1)")?;
+    ///         stmt.execute(["Bob Jones"])?;
+    ///     }
+    ///     Ok(())
+    /// }
+    /// ```
+    ///
+    /// # Failure
+    ///
+    /// Will return `Err` if `sql` cannot be converted to a C-compatible string
+    /// or if the underlying SQLite call fails.
+    #[inline]
+    pub fn prepare_cached(&self, sql: &str) -> Result<CachedStatement<'_>> {
+        self.cache.get(self, sql)
+    }
+
+    /// Set the maximum number of cached prepared statements this connection
+    /// will hold. By default, a connection will hold a relatively small
+    /// number of cached statements. If you need more, or know that you
+    /// will not use cached statements, you
+    /// can set the capacity manually using this method.
+    #[inline]
+    pub fn set_prepared_statement_cache_capacity(&self, capacity: usize) {
+        self.cache.set_capacity(capacity);
+    }
+
+    /// Remove/finalize all prepared statements currently in the cache.
+    #[inline]
+    pub fn flush_prepared_statement_cache(&self) {
+        self.cache.flush();
+    }
+}
+
+/// Prepared statements LRU cache.
+#[derive(Debug)]
+pub struct StatementCache(RefCell<LruCache<Arc<str>, RawStatement>>);
+
+unsafe impl Send for StatementCache {}
+
+/// Cacheable statement.
+///
+/// Statement will return automatically to the cache by default.
+/// If you want the statement to be discarded, call
+/// [`discard()`](CachedStatement::discard) on it.
+pub struct CachedStatement<'conn> {
+    stmt: Option<Statement<'conn>>,
+    cache: &'conn StatementCache,
+}
+
+impl<'conn> Deref for CachedStatement<'conn> {
+    type Target = Statement<'conn>;
+
+    #[inline]
+    fn deref(&self) -> &Statement<'conn> {
+        self.stmt.as_ref().unwrap()
+    }
+}
+
+impl<'conn> DerefMut for CachedStatement<'conn> {
+    #[inline]
+    fn deref_mut(&mut self) -> &mut Statement<'conn> {
+        self.stmt.as_mut().unwrap()
+    }
+}
+
+impl Drop for CachedStatement<'_> {
+    #[inline]
+    fn drop(&mut self) {
+        if let Some(stmt) = self.stmt.take() {
+            self.cache.cache_stmt(unsafe { stmt.into_raw() });
+        }
+    }
+}
+
+impl CachedStatement<'_> {
+    #[inline]
+    fn new<'conn>(stmt: Statement<'conn>, cache: &'conn StatementCache) -> CachedStatement<'conn> {
+        CachedStatement {
+            stmt: Some(stmt),
+            cache,
+        }
+    }
+
+    /// Discard the statement, preventing it from being returned to its
+    /// [`Connection`]'s collection of cached statements.
+    #[inline]
+    pub fn discard(mut self) {
+        self.stmt = None;
+    }
+}
+
+impl StatementCache {
+    /// Create a statement cache.
+    #[inline]
+    pub fn with_capacity(capacity: usize) -> Self {
+        Self(RefCell::new(LruCache::new(capacity)))
+    }
+
+    #[inline]
+    fn set_capacity(&self, capacity: usize) {
+        self.0.borrow_mut().set_capacity(capacity);
+    }
+
+    // Search the cache for a prepared-statement object that implements `sql`.
+    // If no such prepared-statement can be found, allocate and prepare a new one.
+    //
+    // # Failure
+    //
+    // Will return `Err` if no cached statement can be found and the underlying
+    // SQLite prepare call fails.
+    fn get<'conn>(
+        &'conn self,
+        conn: &'conn Connection,
+        sql: &str,
+    ) -> Result<CachedStatement<'conn>> {
+        let trimmed = sql.trim();
+        let mut cache = self.0.borrow_mut();
+        let stmt = match cache.remove(trimmed) {
+            Some(raw_stmt) => Ok(Statement::new(conn, raw_stmt)),
+            None => conn.prepare_with_flags(trimmed, PrepFlags::SQLITE_PREPARE_PERSISTENT),
+        };
+        stmt.map(|mut stmt| {
+            stmt.stmt.set_statement_cache_key(trimmed);
+            CachedStatement::new(stmt, self)
+        })
+    }
+
+    // Return a statement to the cache.
+    fn cache_stmt(&self, mut stmt: RawStatement) {
+        if stmt.is_null() {
+            return;
+        }
+        let mut cache = self.0.borrow_mut();
+        stmt.clear_bindings();
+        if let Some(sql) = stmt.statement_cache_key() {
+            cache.insert(sql, stmt);
+        } else {
+            debug_assert!(
+                false,
+                "bug in statement cache code, statement returned to cache that without key"
+            );
+        }
+    }
+
+    #[inline]
+    fn flush(&self) {
+        let mut cache = self.0.borrow_mut();
+        cache.clear();
+    }
+}
